constraints.action: Apply at least 5 cmH2O of positive end‑expiratory pressure (PEEP) at the time of ARDS diagnosis
Use low tidal volume ventilation (4–8 ml/kg predicted body weight) for all ARDS patients, including COVID‑19 ARDS
Maintain plateau airway pressure (Pplat) below 30 cmH₂O
Measure and adjust tidal volume using predicted body weight (PBW)
Perform prolonged high‑pressure recruitment maneuvers (airway pressure ≥ 35 cmH₂O for ≥ 1 minute)
Routine use of continuous infusions of neuromuscular blocking agents (NMBA) in moderate‑to‑severe ARDS not due to COVID‑19
Use of extracorporeal CO₂ removal (ECCO₂R) for ARDS not due to COVID‑19 outside of randomized controlled trials
Use of extracorporeal CO₂ removal (ECCO₂R) for ARDS due to COVID‑19 outside of randomized controlled trials
Treat severe ARDS (non‑COVID‑19) with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) in an ECMO centre that meets defined organisational standards and follows the EOLIA trial management strategy
Treat severe ARDS due to COVID‑19 with ECMO in an ECMO centre that meets defined organisational standards and follows the EOLIA trial management strategy
Ensure a mobile ECMO team capable of transferring patients on ECMO is available
Provide high‑flow nasal oxygen (HFNO) to non‑mechanically ventilated patients with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (AHRF) not due to cardiogenic pulmonary edema or COPD, including COVID‑19 AHRF

Start prone positioning early after intubation in invasively ventilated ARDS patients after a stabilization period (low tidal volume applied, PEEP adjusted, and PaO₂/FiO₂ < 150 mmHg) and maintain prone for ≥ 16 consecutive hours

constraints.before_action: Stabilization period (low tidal volume ventilation, PEEP adjustment, and PaO₂/FiO₂ < 150 mmHg)
